Headline: 4.06 Lakh Promoter Shares of Multipurpose Finance Converted into Public Shares; Shareholding Ratio Changed To 51: 49
Full Content:

have been converted into public shares making the promoter-to-public shares ratio of the company 51:49.
As of now, the finance company has 4,520,000 unit shares listed in NEPSE. Likewise, the shareholding structure consisted of promotors (60%) and the public (40%) has been converted to 51% Promoter shares and 49% Public shares.
MPFL closed at Rs. 308 yesterday.

Headline: Jebils Finance price falls to Rs 100 while 40% right issue began from yesterday; See the list of other companies trading below Rs 150

However, the last traded price of the share of JEFL was Rs 100 as on Ashadh 11, 2075. Now the problem rises for the company because if the stock follows the bearish trend then the price of the stock will be below its par value. Then the shareholders might not claim for the right shares when they can get the shares of the company in the secondary market below par value.
